limitations.detail: The native harness does not expose encrypted raw prompts, hidden ancestry/event identifiers, or a self-referential receipt digest. The receipt explicitly records those fields as unavailable and does not fabricate them. This review therefore verifies the available native task, model, fork mode, declared inputs, role boundary, output digest, and measured-resource fields; it makes no stronger unsupported ancestry claim.
